Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GRSE to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GRSE Chief General Manager (Finance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the GRSE Chief General Manager (Finance) position is 27 August 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) qualification to be eligible for the Chief General Manager (Finance) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 54 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Chief General Manager (Finance) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Chief General Manager (Finance) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 120000 to Rs. 280000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 590/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chief General Manager (Finance) post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per Government rules for PwBD/Ex-Serviceman candidates, and internal candidates as per GRSE Rules. Relaxation for excess relevant post-qualification experience is also considered.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the GRSE Chief General Manager (Finance) recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.
